1038.description: A machine squat performed with a chair-like support, a stable way to train the legs.
instructions: Position yourself in the machine with the pads on your shoulders and feet shoulder width apart.
Release the safety and brace your core.
Bend your knees and sit back and down.
Drive through your heels to stand back up.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.

1102.description: A leg curl with your hips kept straight. It works the hamstrings.
instructions: Lie on your back with heels in the straps.
Lift your hips into a straight line.
Curl your heels toward you.
Keep your hips high.
Extend slowly.
Repeat.

1166.description: An explosive lunge jump where you switch legs in the air. It builds power and conditioning.
instructions: Start in a split stance with a slight lunge dip.
Drop down and jump up powerfully.
Switch leg positions in mid-air.
Land softly in a lunge with the other leg in front.
Keep your torso upright and repeat at a steady pace.

1230.description: Raising one dumbbell at a time in front of you with a neutral grip. It works the front shoulders.
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your thighs with palms facing in.
Raise one dumbbell straight up to shoulder height.
Pause, then lower it slowly.
Repeat with the other arm and keep alternating.
Avoid swinging your body.

1294.description: A dumbbell pullover on a stability ball combined with a hip lift. It trains the chest and lats while the glutes and core hold your body steady.
instructions: Sit on an exercise ball with your feet flat on the ground and the dumbbell resting on your thighs.
Slowly walk your feet forward, rolling the exercise ball down your back until your head, neck, and upper back are supported on the ball.
Hold the dumbbell with both hands and extend your arms straight up over your chest, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower the dumbbell behind your head, keeping your arms straight and maintaining control.
Pause for a moment, then raise the dumbbell back to the starting position.
While keeping your arms extended, lift your hips off the ground, squeezing your glutes and engaging your core.
Lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地面上，哑铃放在大腿上。
慢慢地向前移动你的脚，将健身球沿着你的背部滚动，直到你的头部、颈部和上背部得到球的支撑。
双手握住哑铃，将手臂伸直至胸部上方，肘部保持轻微弯曲。
将哑铃放在脑后，保持手臂伸直并保持控制。
暂停片刻，然后将哑铃举回到起始位置。
在保持双臂伸展的同时，将臀部抬离地面，挤压臀肌并启动核心肌群。
将臀部放低至起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1358.description: Lie on your side and reach overhead to open up the side of your torso. It stretches the lats and the muscles between your ribs.
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs straight and your bottom arm extended straight overhead.
Bend your top knee and place your foot on the ground in front of your bottom leg.
Reach your top arm over your head and grab onto something stable, like a wall or a piece of furniture.
Slowly lift your bottom leg off the ground, keeping it straight, until you feel a stretch in your side.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, then slowly lower your leg back down.
Repeat on the other side.
instructionsZh: 侧躺，双腿伸直，下臂伸直过头顶。
弯曲上面的膝盖，将脚放在下面的腿前面的地面上。
将上臂伸过头顶，抓住稳定的东西，例如墙壁或一件家具。
慢慢地将下面的腿抬离地面，保持伸直，直到感觉到身体一侧有拉伸感。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒，然后慢慢将腿放下。
在另一侧重复。

1422.description: Lie on your back with your knees bent, tilt your pelvis, then lift into a bridge. It warms up the glutes, lower back and core.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your arms by your sides with your palms facing down.
Engage your glutes and core muscles.
Tilt your pelvis upward, lifting your hips off the ground.
Hold the bridge position for a few seconds.
Slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 仰卧，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将手臂放在身体两侧，手掌朝下。
调动你的臀肌和核心肌肉。
向上倾斜骨盆，将臀部抬离地面。
保持桥位置几秒钟。
慢慢地将臀部放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1486.description: A push-up on handles that lets you go a little deeper and keeps the wrists neutral. It trains the chest, shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Place the handles shoulder-width apart and grip them in a plank position.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest until it is between the handles, elbows about 45 degrees from your body.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight and your hips from sagging.

1550.description: A single-leg squat with the other foot resting on a bench behind you, holding dumbbells. It hammers the quads and glutes and challenges balance.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand a step in front of a bench, facing away from it.
Rest the top of one foot on the bench behind you.
Lower your back knee toward the floor by bending your front leg.
Keep your front knee over your toes and your chest up.
Push through your front heel to stand, then switch legs after your reps.

1614.description: A preacher curl on a lever machine, version 2. The pad locks your upper arms in place so the biceps do the work.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your upper arms resting on the pad and your chest against the support.
Grasp the handles with an underhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your upper arms stationary and exhale as you curl the handles towards your shoulders, contracting your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale as you slowly lower the handles back to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度，将自己放在机器上，上臂放在垫子上，胸部靠在支撑物上。
反手握住手柄，握距略宽于肩宽。
保持上臂静止，呼气，同时将手柄向肩膀卷曲，收缩二头肌。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气，慢慢将手柄放回起始位置，充分伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

1678.description: A hammer curl seated on a bench. It trains the brachialis and the forearms.
instructions: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your torso and arms extended straight down.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the dumbbells until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝向躯干，手臂伸直向下。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举起哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1742.description: A triceps kickback done in a stork stance, balancing on one leg. Adds a balance challenge to the usual triceps isolation.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in your right hand.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Bring your right elbow up to your side, keeping it bent at a 90-degree angle.
Extend your right arm straight back, squeezing your triceps.
Pause for a moment, then slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，右手握住哑铃。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
将右肘举至身体一侧，保持弯曲 90 度角。
将右臂向后伸直，挤压三头肌。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

1806.description: Seated, reaching over to the side stretches your lats and obliques. It is easy on the hips and good for desk breaks.
instructions: Sit tall with your legs crossed or your feet flat and place one hand on the floor beside you.
Reach your other arm up and over your head toward the side, lengthening along your flank.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1870.description: Plate-loaded machine pulldown that trains the lats and upper back.
instructions: Adjust the seat and grip the handles overhead.
Sit tall with your chest up.
Pull down until the handles reach chest level.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly to full stretch.

1934.description: A seated twist with the raised knee and the back leg extended, giving the hip a longer stretch.
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg extended and the other knee bent and crossed over it.
Rotate your torso toward the bent knee, using the opposite elbow to guide it, until the hip stretches.
Keep your spine long and look over your back shoulder.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

2318.description: A machine shoulder press, pushing the handles overhead. Builds shoulder and triceps strength.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and backrest of the leverage machine to a comfortable position.
Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the handles of the machine with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Push the handles upward and forward until your arms are fully extended, but not locked.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the handles back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将杠杆机的座椅高度和靠背调整到舒适的位置。
坐在机器上，背部靠在靠背上，双脚平放在地板上。
正手握住机器的手柄，握距略宽于肩宽。
向上和向前推动手柄，直到手臂完全伸展，但未锁定。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手柄放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2766.description: Rotating the forearm so the palm turns up. Helps forearm control and wrist mobility.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Hold your elbow close to your side bent at 90 degrees, palm facing down.
Rotate your forearm so your palm turns up to face the ceiling.
Keep the elbow still and pause briefly at the end.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2830.description: A rear lunge while pushing or holding a power sled. Builds leg strength with extra resistance.
instructions: Hold the sled handles and stand tall with your feet together.
Step one foot back into a lunge, lowering your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee over your ankle.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs on each rep.

2894.description: A plank where one arm lifts at a time, challenging core stability and anti-rotation.
instructions: Set up in a forearm plank with elbows under shoulders.
Squeeze your glutes and keep a straight line from head to heels.
Lift one arm forward without letting your hips twist.
Return it and lift the other arm.
Alternate in a slow, controlled rhythm.

3086.description: A standing move where you twist to bring an elbow toward the opposite knee. It raises your pulse and works the sides of your waist.
instructions: Stand tall with your hands behind your head.
Lift one knee up and across your body.
Twist your torso to meet the knee with the opposite elbow.
Return to standing.
Alternate sides at a steady pace.
Keep your chest lifted and breathe evenly.

3150.description: A chin tuck with light help from your hand to guide the movement and feel the right position.
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your eyes level.
Place two fingers on your chin.
Gently guide your chin straight back.
Keep your head level and your shoulders relaxed.
Hold for 3-5 seconds.
Release and repeat 8-10 times.

3214.description: A standing toe touch with a circular path and a leg lifting behind you. It loosens the hamstrings and challenges balance.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and arms extended to the sides.
Keeping your legs straight, bend forward at the waist and reach down towards your toes with your right hand.
As you reach down, simultaneously lift your left leg straight up behind you, maintaining balance.
Return to the starting position and repeat the movement with your left hand reaching towards your toes and your right leg lifting up behind you.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双臂向两侧伸展。
保持双腿伸直，腰部向前弯曲，右手向下伸向脚趾。
当你向下伸展时，同时将左腿在身后伸直，保持平衡。
返回起始位置，重复该动作，左手伸向脚趾，右腿在身后抬起。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

3342.description: A cable raise that moves your arms into a Y shape, building the shoulders and the muscles that stabilise your shoulder blades.
instructions: Set the pulleys low and hold a handle in each hand, arms crossed in front.
Stand tall with a slight lean forward.
Raise both arms up and out into a Y shape.
Keep your thumbs pointing up and shoulders down.
Lower slowly to the start.

3470.description: A bodyweight lunge stepping forward and pushing back, alternating legs. It builds the glutes, quads and balance.
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and hands on your hips.
Take a big step forward with your right foot, lowering your body into a lunge position.
Bend your right knee to about 90 degrees, keeping your knee aligned with your ankle.
Push off with your right foot and return to the starting position.
Repeat with your left leg, alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站立，双脚分开与臀部同宽，双手放在臀部。
右脚向前迈出一大步，将身体降低到弓步位置。
将右膝盖弯曲约 90 度，保持膝盖与脚踝对齐。
用右脚推出并返回到起始位置。
用左腿重复上述动作，交替进行所需的重复次数。

3534.description: A standing calf raise with small pulses at the top. It builds calf endurance.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a support for balance.
Rise up onto the balls of your feet.
Pulse up and down in small movements.
Keep your knees straight.
Lower fully when you finish.
Keep the movement controlled.

3662.description: A push-up flow that moves from pike position down and through to a cobra. It trains the shoulders, chest and spine mobility.
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your feet together.
Engage your core and lift your hips up towards the ceiling, forming an inverted V shape with your body.
Lower your upper body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your body.
As you lower down, shift your weight forward and transition into a cobra pose by straightening your arms and lifting your chest up.
Reverse the movement by bending your elbows and lowering your chest back down towards the ground.
Push through your hands to return to the inverted V position.
Continue the movement by lowering your hips back down towards the ground, returning to the starting push-up position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽，双脚并拢。
收紧核心肌群，将臀部抬向天花板，与身体形成倒V字形。
弯曲肘部，使上半身靠近地面，使上半身靠近地面。
当你下降时，将你的重心向前移动，并通过伸直手臂并抬起胸部来过渡到眼镜蛇姿势。
通过弯曲肘部并将胸部放回到地面来扭转运动。
双手用力推回到倒V字形。
通过将臀部放回地面继续运动，回到起始俯卧撑位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3726.description: A seated front raise with a barbell that trains the front delts without using leg drive.
instructions: Sit on a bench holding a barbell with an overhand grip, resting on your thighs.
Raise the bar straight in front of you to shoulder height.
Pause at the top.
Lower it slowly to your thighs.
Keep your back straight and avoid swinging.

3790.description: Side steps in a half squat while holding the band out in front of you. It works your hips and resists rotation through the core.
instructions: Anchor the band at chest height and stand side-on to it.
Press the handle straight out and sink into a quarter squat.
Take small steps sideways away from the anchor, keeping your torso square.
Step back in under control.
Repeat for your set, then switch sides.

3854.description: From standing, you walk your hands out to a plank and back. It trains your core, shoulders and hamstring flexibility.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
Hinge forward and place your hands on the floor.
Walk your hands out to a front plank.
Hold briefly with your hips level.
Walk your hands back and stand up.

3918.description: A single-leg Romanian deadlift holding a landmine bar, challenging balance and the hamstrings.
instructions: Hold the end of a landmine bar with both hands.
Stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Hinge at the hips and extend the other leg behind you.
Lower the bar toward the floor with a flat back.
Squeeze your glute to stand.
Switch legs after your reps.

3982.description: From a front plank, drive one knee to the chest and alternate. It trains the core and hip flexors.
instructions: Start in a high plank.
Draw one knee toward your chest.
Return it to the floor.
Alternate legs.
Keep your hips level.

4046.description: Deadlift from a wide stance with a kettlebell between your feet. It trains the glutes, thighs and back.
instructions: Stand with feet wide and toes angled out, the kettlebell between your feet.
Hinge and bend your knees to grip the handle with both hands.
Keep your back flat and chest up.
Drive through your feet to stand tall and squeeze your glutes.
Lower the kettlebell under control.

4110.description: A seated curl that turns your palms down on the way back, training biceps and forearms.
instructions: Sit upright holding dumbbells with palms facing forward.
Curl both dumbbells up to shoulder height.
At the top rotate your palms to face down.
Lower slowly in that reverse grip.
Rotate your palms back up at the bottom.

4174.description: A plate loaded press with a reverse grip on a lever machine. It targets the front shoulders.
instructions: Adjust the seat and sit with your back against the pad.
Grip the handles with a reverse grip.
Press the handles up until your arms are extended.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly to shoulder level.
Keep your core braced.

4238.description: A seated raise that combines a side raise and a front raise in one rep. It builds the delts from two angles.
instructions: Sit tall on a bench holding light dumbbells at your sides.
Raise both arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Lower them back to your sides.
Raise both arms to the front to shoulder height.
Lower and repeat.
Avoid leaning back or swinging.

4366.description: A standing crunch where you lift a knee to the side toward your elbow. It works the obliques.
instructions: Stand tall with your hands behind your head.
Lift one knee out to the side.
Crunch your elbow down toward it.
Return to standing.
Repeat on both sides.

4430.description: A gentle neck exercise lying on your side and lifting the head against light resistance to strengthen the side neck muscles.
instructions: Lie on your side with your head supported at the edge of the bench.
Place a light weight or plate on the side of your head, held steady.
Lift your head slowly toward the ceiling.
Pause, then lower under control.
Complete your reps, then switch sides. Use light weight.

4494.description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the inside of the forearm (flexors). A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
instructions: Place the ball under your inside of the forearm (flexors) on a table with your palm facing up.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

4558.description: A yoga flow that moves from a resting child pose into a gentle backbend, mobilising the spine.
instructions: Start in child pose, knees apart, arms stretched forward.
Shift forward and lower your chest toward the floor.
Slide forward and press into your hands to lift your chest into cobra.
Keep your hips down and your shoulders away from your ears.
Hold for a few breaths.
Push back into child pose and repeat.

4622.description: A plank with one arm lifting a dumbbell forward, challenging your core to stay still.
instructions: Start in a forearm or high plank with a dumbbell in one hand.
Brace your abs and keep hips level.
Lift the dumbbell forward in line with your torso.
Lower it with control.
Alternate arms for the set.

4686.description: An overhead press with the band starting behind the head. It trains the shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the ends behind your head at shoulder level.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down.
Press your hands straight overhead.
Lock out your arms without shrugging.
Lower slowly back behind your head and repeat.

4750.description: A Russian twist with a dumbbell and your feet lifted off the floor. It strongly challenges the obliques and balance.
instructions: Sit down and lean back slightly with a dumbbell held in both hands.
Lift your feet off the floor with knees bent.
Rotate your torso to bring the dumbbell beside one hip.
Twist to the other side in a controlled way.
Keep your chest up and your back long.

4942.description: An arm swing from a stationary stance. It warms up the shoulders and upper back.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder width apart and arms at your sides.
Swing your arms up and back in a throwing motion.
Rotate through your torso slightly.
Keep the movement smooth and rhythmic.
Switch arms or alternate.
Continue for 20-30 seconds.

5006.description: An inverted row on suspension straps with an underhand grip. It builds the back and biceps.
instructions: Hold the handles palms up and lean back with a straight body.
Brace your core.
Pull your chest toward your hands.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower yourself slowly.
Walk your feet forward to make it harder.

5070.description: Step back into a lunge while holding a kettlebell. Stepping backward is kind on the knees and loads the glutes and quads.
instructions: Stand tall holding a kettlebell at your chest or by your side.
Step one foot back and lower until both knees are about 90 degrees.
Keep your torso upright and front heel down.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

5134.description: A seated arm movement like a ballet arm sweep. It loosens the shoulders and warms up the upper body.
instructions: Sit tall with arms by your sides.
Sweep your arms out and up in a wide arc.
Bring your hands overhead.
Lower them back with control.
Keep the movement graceful.
Repeat at an easy pace.

5198.description: Holding a glute bridge with one leg straight. It trains the glutes and challenges hip stability.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Straighten one leg.
Lift your hips with the planted foot.
Hold with hips level.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower and switch legs.

5326.description: A lat pulldown on a lever machine using rope handles. The multi-mode setup lets you vary the pulling path.
instructions: Sit at the machine and grab the rope handles.
Set your thighs under the pads and sit tall.
Pull the handles down toward your upper chest.
Drive your elbows down and back.
Let the handles rise slowly until your arms are straight.
Avoid leaning back too far.

5390.description: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the glutes. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructions: Sit on the roller with your hands behind you.
Place the roller under the glutes and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll slowly back and forth under your glutes.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

5518.description: One-arm cable row from a kneeling position, leaning forward to give a long pull for the lats and mid back.
instructions: Kneel facing a low cable with a handle in one hand.
Lean your torso forward and brace your core.
Pull your elbow back toward your hip.
Squeeze your shoulder blade, then return slowly.
Finish reps and switch sides.

5582.description: Lunge stepping backward from a raised surface, which increases the range of motion.
instructions: Stand on a low step with feet together.
Step one leg back and down to the floor.
Lower into a lunge with the front knee over the foot.
Push through the front heel to step back up.
Complete reps and switch legs.

5774.description: Hip thrusts done on one leg with your upper back on a support. Builds glute strength and hip stability.
instructions: Rest your upper back on a bench with one foot flat and the other leg lifted.
Keep your arms out for balance.
Drive through your heel to lift your hips until level.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower with control and switch legs after your reps.

5902.description: A one-leg balance with the ankle crossed over the opposite knee. Stretches the outer hip.
instructions: Stand tall and shift your weight onto one leg.
Cross the other ankle over the standing thigh.
Bend your standing knee and sit your hips back.
Hold for 5 slow breaths with a long spine.
Switch legs.

5966.description: A jump with a midair trunk rotation that trains explosive leg power and core control.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart in a slight squat.
Jump up and rotate your hips and feet to one side.
Land softly with bent knees.
Jump again and twist to the other side.
Keep your chest up and land quietly.

6094.description: A standing move where you drive a knee up and tap beneath it with your hands. It warms up the hips and works the abs.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your hands out in front.
Lift one knee up and forward to hip height.
Reach both hands under that thigh and tap beneath the knee.
Lower the foot with control and switch legs.
Keep your chest up and stay light on your feet.
Alternate sides at a steady, bouncy pace.

6158.description: A seated overhead extension with one dumbbell. It isolates the triceps.
instructions: Sit upright holding a dumbbell in one hand overhead.
Keep the upper arm close to your head.
Lower the dumbbell behind your head by bending the elbow.
Extend the arm back to full lockout.
Keep your core braced.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

6222.description: A squat jump holding suspension straps for balance. It builds explosive leg power.
instructions: Hold the straps with your arms extended.
Lower into a squat.
Jump up explosively.
Land softly.
Go straight into the next squat.
Keep your chest tall.

6350.description: Lying face down, you lift your arms into a Y shape to strengthen the muscles that stabilise your shoulder blades.
instructions: Lie face down with your arms stretched overhead in a Y shape.
Keep your forehead near the floor and your neck long.
Lift your arms off the floor by squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause for a second at the top.
Lower your arms slowly and repeat.

6542.description: A kneeling cable fly pulling from high to low across your body, working the lower chest.
instructions: Set the cables high and kneel between them, holding a handle in each hand.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Sweep your arms down and together in front of your hips.
Squeeze your chest at the bottom.
Return slowly and repeat.

6606.description: A curtsey lunge on the smith machine that steps one leg behind and across the other. It hits the glutes and outer hips with a stable bar path.
instructions: Set the bar on your upper back and unrack it, feet hip-width apart.
Step one leg back and diagonally behind the other, like a curtsey.
Lower until your front thigh is near parallel, chest tall.
Press through the front heel to return to standing.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

6734.description: A one-leg press on an angled sled. It loads each leg separately for strength and balance.
instructions: Sit in the angled sled and place one foot in the middle of the platform.
Release the safety and lower the sled by bending the knee.
Go as deep as you can with your back against the pad.
Press through your heel to straighten the leg without locking out.
Keep your hips flat on the seat.
Finish the reps and switch legs.

6798.description: A standing band kickback that builds the glutes while challenging your balance on one leg.
instructions: Loop the band around your ankles or hold it under your standing foot.
Stand on one leg with a slight bend in the knee and brace your abs.
Kick the other leg straight back against the band.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching your lower back.
Return slowly with control.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

7054.description: A standing twisting move holding a dumbbell that works the forearm rotators. It builds wrist and grip strength.
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell by its handle in front of you.
Keep your elbows bent and close to your sides.
Rotate your forearms and wrists inward and outward.
Move slowly through the full range.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.

7310.description: A seated stretch using a chair to lengthen the back of the thigh without a deep fold.
instructions: Sit on the front edge of a chair.
Straighten one leg with the heel on the floor and toes up.
Keep the other foot flat and your back long.
Hinge forward at the hips until you feel a stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Switch legs.

7374.description: Wide-stance deadlift on the smith machine that trains glutes and inner thighs.
instructions: Stand with feet wide, toes turned out, and grip the bar inside your knees.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Push your feet into the floor and stand tall.
Lock out your hips at the top.
Lower the bar by pushing your hips back.

7566.description: Hack squat with dumbbells held behind the legs.
instructions: Hold dumbbells behind you with your heels slightly raised.
Keep your chest up.
Squat down.
Stay tall.
Drive up through your feet.

8142.description: A leg press performed lying on your back using a band around your feet. It works the quads and glutes.
instructions: Lie on your back and loop a band around your feet, holding the ends.
Bring your knees toward your chest.
Press your feet away until your legs are almost straight.
Control the band as it pulls you back.
Repeat for your reps.

8654.description: A seated overhead extension that works the triceps using your own arm resistance.
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Raise your arms overhead and bend your elbows so your hands drop behind your head.
Extend your arms back up until straight.
Lower slowly and keep your elbows pointing forward.

9486.description: A gymnastics-style hollow position on your back with arms and legs reaching away. It builds strong, braced abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with arms overhead and legs straight.
Press your lower back into the floor and tighten your abs.
Lift your arms, shoulders and legs a few centimetres off the floor.
Keep your body in a shallow dish shape and breathe.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then relax.

9870.description: A single-arm Y raise while supported on an incline bench, working the shoulders and upper back.
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with a cable handle in one hand.
Let your arm hang down.
Raise it up and out in a Y shape.
Pause with your thumb up.
Lower slowly, then switch arms.

10126.description: Press the back of your hand into a towel on a wall while standing. It trains the rotator cuff without moving the joint.
instructions: Stand next to a wall with a towel between the back of your hand and the wall.
Bend your elbow to 90 degrees, tucked at your side.
Press your hand outward into the towel.
Hold the effort for 10 to 20 seconds.
Relax, then switch sides.

10190.description: A one-arm push press with a landmine, using leg drive to move the bar up and the shoulder to control it.
instructions: Stand facing the landmine end and hold it at your shoulder with one hand.
Dip a few inches by bending your knees.
Drive up with your legs and press the bar up and forward until your arm is straight.
Lower the end back to your shoulder with control.
Keep your ribs down and brace your core. Finish the reps, then switch arms.

11278.description: A standing side bend that loads the obliques with a cable. It trains your core to resist and control sideways motion.
instructions: Stand side-on to a low pulley and hold the handle at your side.
Keep your chest tall.
Bend sideways away from the machine.
Contract your obliques to return upright.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

11790.description: A balance drill where you stand on one leg and tap the other foot to three points, training hip control and stability.
instructions: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend and your hands on your hips.
Tap the free foot out in front of you, then lightly out to the side.
Tap it behind you, keeping your torso upright.
Return to center and repeat the sequence under control.
Complete all reps, then switch legs.

0014.description: A seated medicine ball twist, from side to side, that trains the obliques and abs with a leaned-back torso.
instructions: Sit on the ground with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Hold the medicine ball with both hands in front of your chest.
Lean back slightly, engaging your abs and keeping your back straight.
Slowly twist your torso to the right, bringing the medicine ball towards the right side of your body.
Pause for a moment, then twist your torso to the left, bringing the medicine ball towards the left side of your body.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在地上，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地板上。
双手将健身球放在胸前。
稍微向后倾斜，收紧腹肌并保持背部挺直。
慢慢地将你的躯干向右扭转，将健身球移向身体的右侧。
暂停片刻，然后将躯干向左扭转，将健身球移向身体左侧。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

0078.description: A reverse lunge with the bar across the back. Easy on the knees and strong for the glutes.
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and a barbell resting on your upper back.
Take a step backward with your right foot, landing on the ball of your foot.
Bend both knees to lower your body until your left thigh is parallel to the ground.
Push through your left heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat with the other leg.
instructionsZh: 首先，双脚分开与肩同宽，将杠铃放在上背部。
右脚向后退一步，用脚掌着地。
弯曲双膝降低身体，直到左大腿与地面平行。
推动左脚跟返回到起始位置。
换另一条腿重复上述步骤。

0142.description: A plank-style bridge hold supported on the knees. It builds trunk endurance with less load than a full plank.
instructions: Kneel on a mat and lean forward onto your forearms.
Position your elbows under your shoulders.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line from knees to head.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower gently and rest.

0206.description: A reverse curl with a bar on a low pulley, using an overhand grip. It works the forearms and the biceps under steady tension.
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley cable machine.
Stand facing the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Grasp the bar with an underhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and your upper arms stationary throughout the exercise.
Exhale and curl the bar up towards your shoulders, contracting your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the bar back to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将直杆连接到低滑轮电缆机上。
面向机器站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖稍微弯曲。
反手握住杠铃，双手与肩同宽。
在整个练习过程中，保持肘部靠近身体两侧，上臂保持静止。
呼气并将杠铃向上卷向肩膀，收缩二头肌。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气，慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置，充分伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

0334.description: The standard standing dumbbell lateral raise. Lifting the arms out to the sides builds the side delts.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your body.
Keep your back straight and engage your core.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they are parallel to the floor, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体。
保持背部挺直并启动核心肌群。
将手臂向两侧抬起，直到与地板平行，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0398.description: Seated and bent forward, you straighten one arm behind you with a dumbbell. It isolates the triceps one side at a time.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and hold a dumbbell in one hand.
Bend your torso forward at the waist, keeping your back straight and parallel to the ground.
Extend your arm straight back, keeping your elbow close to your body.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，一手握住哑铃。
将躯干的腰部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直并与地面平行。
将手臂向后伸直，保持肘部靠近身体。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

0462.description: A gentle neck stretch where you tip your head forward and then back to loosen the front and back of the neck.
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly lower your chin toward your chest until you feel a stretch at the back of the neck.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Raise your head and slowly tip it back to look up.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, staying comfortable.
Move slowly and keep your breathing relaxed.

0526.description: You clean two kettlebells alternately from a hang to the rack. It works the hips, back, shoulders and grip.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in each hand with an overhand grip.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and chest up.
Allow the kettlebells to hang straight down in front of your body.
In one fluid motion, explosively extend your hips and knees while shrugging your shoulders.
As the kettlebells rise, pull them up towards your shoulders, keeping your elbows high and out to the sides.
Catch the kettlebells at shoulder height, with your palms facing inward and your elbows pointing forward.
Lower the kettlebells back down to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个壶铃，正手握住。
稍微弯曲膝盖，臀部向前转动，保持背部挺直，挺胸。
让壶铃垂直悬挂在身体前方。
以一种流畅的动作，爆发性地伸展臀部和膝盖，同时耸肩。
当壶铃上升时，将其拉向肩膀，保持肘部高且向两侧伸展。
在与肩同高的位置抓住壶铃，手掌朝内，肘部向前。
将壶铃放回起始位置，然后重复所需的重复次数。

0590.description: Seated on a machine, you press one handle overhead at a time. Trains each shoulder separately with help from the triceps.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your back against the pad.
Grasp the lever handle with one hand and position your elbow at a 90-degree angle.
Press the lever upward until your arm is fully extended overhead.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the lever back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度并将自己放在机器上，背部靠在垫子上。
用一只手抓住杠杆手柄，并将肘部置于 90 度角。
向上按下控制杆，直到手臂完全伸过头顶。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将控制杆放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。

0654.description: A push-up where you pull a knee toward your chest on each rep. It adds core and conditioning work.
instructions: Start in a plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Lower into a push-up.
Press back up.
Drive one knee toward your chest.
Return that foot to the plank.
Alternate legs each rep.

0718.description: A sit-up performed with a sideways angle. It emphasizes the obliques.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Place your hands behind your head.
Sit up while reaching one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Lower slowly.
Keep your feet planted.
Alternate sides.

0782.description: A quick hopping drill where you jump around the corners of an imaginary square. It builds foot speed, agility and leg power.
instructions: Imagine a square on the floor and stand at one corner.
Hop on both feet to the next corner, staying light on your toes.
Keep hopping around the square in order.
Land softly with slightly bent knees.
Reverse direction halfway through your set.

0846.description: A seated Russian twist holding a weight, rotating side to side. It trains the obliques and abs.
instructions: Sit on the ground with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor.
Hold a weight or medicine ball with both hands in front of your chest.
Lean back slightly, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Slowly twist your torso to the right, bringing the weight or medicine ball towards the floor on your right side.
Pause for a moment, then twist your torso to the left, bringing the weight or medicine ball towards the floor on your left side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在地上，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地板上。
双手握住重物球或健身球放在胸前。
稍微向后倾斜，保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
慢慢地将你的躯干向右扭转，将重物或药球拉向右侧的地板。
暂停片刻，然后将躯干向左扭转，将重物或健身球拉向左侧的地板。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

0910.description: A lying raise lifting the legs and hips with a band. It works the lower abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with the band set around your feet or anchored.
Lift your legs toward the ceiling.
Curl your hips off the floor.
Lower slowly.
Keep your lower back controlled.

0974.description: A close-grip pulldown with a band, pulling down toward the chest. It trains the lats and biceps.
instructions: Attach the band to a high anchor point, such as a pull-up bar or sturdy beam.
Stand facing the anchor point and grab the band with an underhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Step back to create tension in the band, keeping your feet hip-width apart.
Engage your core and keep your back straight as you pull the band down towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, then slowly release the band back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将弹力带固定在较高的锚点上，例如上拉杆或坚固的横梁。
面向锚点站立，用反手抓住弹力带，双手与肩同宽。
后退一步，在弹力带上产生张力，双脚分开与臀部同宽。
当你将弹力带向下拉向胸部时，收紧你的核心并保持背部挺直，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作底部暂停片刻，然后慢慢松开弹力带回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
